title: AX – Google’s Open Agentic Orchestrator
summary: AX is Google's open-source agentic orchestrator, presented via agentexecutor.io and discussed on Hacker News with 564 points and 255 comments. It provides a framework for coordinating autonomous AI agents, likely integrating with Google's ecosystem and LLM tooling. The high engagement suggests strong developer interest in standardized agent orchestration infrastructure.
